class.name: GIFRecorder
class.brief_description: Records a viewport, window, or screen to an animated GIF.
class.description: Works in the editor and in exported templates. Capture a [Viewport] with [method start_viewport], the engine window with [method start_window], or a display with [method start_screen]. Tests and manual control can push images with [method add_frame]. Call [method stop] then [method save], or use [method record_viewport] for a timed clip.

method.name: add_frame
method.description: Appends a prepared frame. Used by unit tests and manual capture.

method.name: is_recording
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a timed capture is running.

method.name: record_viewport
method.description: Records [param viewport] for [param duration_sec] seconds and writes [param path].

method.name: start_viewport
method.description: Starts capturing [param viewport] each process frame.

method.name: start_window
method.description: Starts capturing the main engine or game window, including decorations.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops capture and returns the recorded animation.

members.member: Capture rate and encoded frame delay.
Netscape loop count written on encode. [code]0[/code] is infinite.
Downscales captured frames that exceed this size. [code](0, 0)[/code] disables scaling.

signal.name: recording_finished
signal.description: Emitted when [method stop] finishes. [param path] is set when a pending save path was provided.

constants.constant: Capture the engine or game window.
